title: Neon Abyss
prepared_input_summary: Frantic roguelite action-platformer with run-and-gun combat, unlimited item synergies, dungeon evolution and runs that change the ruleset.
relevant_profile_signals: Active moment-to-moment gameplay is critically important.
Development and variety are critically important; repetition is tolerated when the core loop keeps evolving.

decision_basis: The prepared semantic input itself establishes a fast active loop plus explicit run-to-run rule changes and item-synergy development, directly matching high-weight profile preferences. No external retrieval was necessary for a provisional moderate fit.
continuation_reason: Prepared input was sufficient and no observable runtime/tool/platform stop condition occurred.
